# use-postgres

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse postgres facade.

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-postgres/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-postgres/llms-full.txt. The /facades/use-postgres/ routes serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
